title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.29
subtitle: GAIA with CUDA and a clearer Solver Engine section.

highlights.title: GAIA with CUDA
highlights.description: Bakes with GAIA and the CUDA backend run again; CUDA is still checked on your GPU first.

highlights.title: Clearer Solver Engine section
highlights.description: The active engine and its Bake options come first, one row per engine follows, details stay collapsed.

highlights.title: Engine stays yours
highlights.description: AETHER and GAIA never switch on their own; install and update each engine from its own row.
